exercises.name: 21s Bicep Curl

source_english.description: A 21s Bicep Curl divides the barbell set into lower-half, upper-half, and full-range curls, keeping the elbows fixed throughout.
instructions: Stand tall with the barbell held at arm's length and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar through the lower half of the range for seven controlled repetitions.
Curl through the upper half of the range for seven controlled repetitions.
Perform seven full-range curls from straight arms to shoulder height, then lower under control.
form_cues: Use the same controlled tempo in each segment.
common_mistakes: Turning the 21s sequence into ordinary full-range curls.
Swinging the bar to finish repetitions.
source_english.safety_note: Choose a barbell load that permits all three segments without swinging.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)

source_english.description: The Arnold Press starts with the dumbbells at the shoulders, rotates the palms outward during the press, and reverses that rotation on the way down.
instructions: Sit or stand tall holding the dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press upward while rotating the palms to face forward.
Finish with the weights over the shoulders without shrugging.
Lower through the same rotation back to the start.
form_cues: Keep the ribs stacked over the pelvis.
Do not force the overhead range.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light enough dumbbell pair to control the rotation overhead.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)

source_english.description: Bent Over Row (Barbell) pulls the barbell toward the lower ribs from a fixed hip hinge.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge until the torso is inclined, and grip the resistance.
Pull toward the lower ribs while keeping the spine fixed.
Pause with elbows behind the torso and shoulders away from the ears.
Lower until the arms lengthen, then reset.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load that lets the torso or chest support remain fixed throughout the row.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)

source_english.description: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell) keeps the rear foot on a bench while the front leg lowers and rises under a barbell across the upper back.
instructions: Place the top of the right foot on a bench behind you and position the barbell across the upper back.
Set the left foot far enough forward for the heel to stay down.
Bend both knees until the left thigh approaches parallel while the torso stays upright.
Drive through the left foot to stand, then complete the other side.
form_cues: Track the front knee over the toes.
common_mistakes: Leaning forward to escape the bottom.
source_english.safety_note: Use a low bench and a rack or spotter; reduce the load if the rear-foot balance shifts.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)

source_english.description: Decline Bench Press (Barbell) is a supported chest press using the barbell.
instructions: Lie on a declined bench with feet secured. Grip the barbell and hold it over the chest.
Lower the resistance toward the chest with elbows controlled.
Pause without bouncing or losing shoulder position.
Press back to straight arms, then rerack or set the weights down safely.
source_english.safety_note: Use a spotter or safeties for the loaded press and stop before shoulder control is lost.

source_english.safety_note: Use a wall or spotter and stop before the head or shoulders contact uncontrollably.
